text.en: Clients frequently express long-term loyalty to Dr Berk and Dr Shatila, who have served local families for many years with dedication and kindness. Pet owners value straightforward clinical guidance, compassionate end-of-life support, and an unhurried consultation style. While two clients reported administrative oversights and vaccine miscommunication, most praise the doctors' genuine devotion to pet health.

Pet parents highlight the compassionate attention provided to senior dogs and cats facing chronic ailments or end-of-life transitions. Reviewers note that clinical staff treat beloved animals with profound respect, ensuring examinations and surgical interventions remain calm and reassuring. Clients appreciate that vets focus on the comfort and wellbeing of each patient.

Several pet owners praise prompt telephone assistance, direct access to veterinary technicians, and helpful email guidance between routine visits. Conversely, critical reviewers report disorganized administrative records, unreturned messages, and an incident where extra vaccines were administered without explicit owner confirmation. Clear pre-appointment communication regarding planned procedures is advised.

q.en: Can clients speak directly with veterinary technicians by phone?

a.en: Yes, pet owners appreciate that clinic staff answer calls directly without navigating complicated automated telephone menus.

q.en: What parking amenities are available at the clinic?

a.en: Clients report that the practice offers convenient parking within a dedicated surface lot located directly off the freeway.

q.en: Does the clinic support families during end-of-life care?

a.en: Reviewers highlight Dr Berk's compassionate hospice support and empathetic handling during the peaceful passing of senior pets.

q.en: Are treatment options and costs explained beforehand?

a.en: Clients generally appreciate candid cost assessments, though one owner noted surprise fees when extra vaccines were administered.
